# Ui

<!-- generated by `kit scan` · inputs: **/*.csproj, **/*.xaml, **/*.razor, **/*.cshtml, **/*ViewModel*.cs · do not edit: decisions go in .claude/decisions/ -->

| fact                                                 | value |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| UI framework                                         | WinUI 3 (Windows App SDK) |
| MVVM library                                         | CommunityToolkit.Mvvm |
| view model base classes                              | ObservableRecipient |
| [ObservableProperty] fields                          | some |
| [RelayCommand] methods                               | some |
| ObservableCollection<T> for lists                    | yes |
| view model resolved in code-behind via the container | most |
| navigation                                           | Frame.Navigate, own INavigationService |
| view models hold UI controls                         | some |
| async void methods (not event handlers)              | yes |
| x:Bind / Binding in XAML                             | Binding, x:Bind |
| localised resources (.resw / .resx)                  | yes |
| hard-coded user-visible text                         | yes |

## Notes

- async void outside event handlers: exceptions crash the app and callers cannot await. With CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, an async Task [RelayCommand] gives an AsyncRelayCommand.
